component.name: Check for updates…
component.summary: Download and install updates from Devuan and LCOS

description.p: A small GTK 3 tool that checks for and installs software updates from Devuan and LCOS. It runs only when you open it: no background daemon, no tray icon and no automatic installs.

It shows each update before installing, offers Restart when a new kernel, firmware or microcode needs one, can finish an interrupted install with Repair, and can remove packages that are no longer needed.
Version for LCOS 1.0.0. No functional changes.
Offers Restart after kernel, firmware and microcode updates, deletes downloaded package files after installing, and can remove packages that are no longer needed.
Repair for interrupted installs, setup-question notices and answers, package sizes, and many fixes.
